name: Rajiv Gandhi
summary: Gandhi advocated technological modernisation, selective economic liberalisation, rural development and stronger local democracy. He promoted nuclear disarmament and nonalignment while authorising regional military interventions; his secular commitments were complicated by concessions to religious personal law.
